## Current Release Notes * Potentially fixed a rare freeze in the Conflict Solver diff viewer * Update Chinese translation (thanks to KrukaL for the PR) * Expose some windows rendering options
## Release Notes 1.27 * Update dependencies * HOI4 1.17 CS support * Stellaris 4.2 CS support * EU5 mod management support * Proton game launching on Linux * Optional GenerateSteamAppId flag to create steam_appid.txt when missing (used for enabling Steam activity tracking when launching games directly; off by default) * Added StoragePath setting to customize where Irony stores and reads its data * Irony is now Flatpak-aware (detects and supports Steam Flatpak installations)

item.title: 1.28.97-alpha
item.description:
## Current Release Notes
* Latest Stellaris CS support * Fix Open Release Page to open the exact offered update release, including prerelease versions.
## Release Notes 1.28
* Upgrade to .NET 10 * Update dependencies * Update Steamworks.NET * Update LiteDB * Modernize CWTools integration * Improve Wayland support * Fix deployment bugs on OSX\Linux * Improve Windows rendering recovery for rare blank or unresponsive windows * Improve deterministic build composition * Generalize Avalonia build workaround * Harden update artifact signature validation * Remove obsolete image parsing references * Remove SharpCompress * Update localization * Improve parser compatibility * Improve Compress Merge writable preflight * Improve collection rename progress feedback * Add per-game filesystem safety and recovery * Preserve missing collection mods as virtual entries * Preserve missing mods when importing collections * Improve collection persistence across unavailable mod sources * Add controlled recovery after changing mod directories * Skip unavailable mods when applying or launching collections * Preserve missing-mod metadata when exporting collections * Add visual indicators for unavailable collection mods * Improve virtual mod removal and collection membership handling * Add virtual-mod-aware collection undo and redo * Add local mod aliases * Search mods by local alias * Add Advanced Filter UI for mod search * Add exact mod-set Ignore Rules to Conflict Solver * Add GUI management for exact mod-set Ignore Rules with Add/Delete and read-only preview * Preserve exact mod-set Ignore Rules through Conflict Solver persistence and legacy rule editing * Note: Exact mod-set Ignore Rules are new in 1.28 and are not understood correctly by older Irony versions * Improve Options scaling and accessibility * Add responsive Options layout for high-DPI and small viewports * Add macOS application bundle packaging * Improve macOS Finder launch compatibility * Improve macOS update experience with manual release-page updates * Improve conflict analysis equivalence filtering
